rules.rule: A direct promise exists as final only after both authenticated room participants approve the exact current proposal version in one DO transaction. Missing response, repeated own approval, AI decision or D1 projection cannot stand for another user's consent.

Direct schedule changes remain separate candidates until both users explicitly approve the exact change revision; negotiations invalidate old approvals, and superseded/stale requests cannot apply a new schedule. Preserve each version's consent history.

Group host confirmation never answers attendance for another user. Require the canonical schedule expectedVersion before every own RSVP, including idempotent retries; reject missing/stale versions after schedule changes reset responses.

Keep proposal approvals, change revisions and final approvals in owned DO SQLite and logical backups. Restart/restore retains waiting and negotiated states; revoke sessions and ephemeral reviews. Legacy direct records lacking proof never become mutually confirmed by inference.
DO canonical authority controls every membership, consent, RSVP and invitation grant; D1 projection never grants access.
Exact persisted epoch/revision/payload acknowledgement precedes outbox deletion; no-op writes retain outbox.
Quota/error rollback cannot partially create messages/promises; retry canonical id/version.
Invite/rejoin floors guard messages, proposals, delayed confirmations, receipts and snapshots.
